List the curated Statistical Abstract tables

Source: R/abstract.R
knbs_abstract_tables.Rd

The Statistical Abstract publishes its chapter tables as Excel workbooks on the KNBS website. This function lists the tables the package has curated: each one has a hand-verified extraction recipe — sheet, layout anchors, section labels, unit and pinned reference values — so that knbs_abstract_table() can return it as clean tidy observations, or refuse with a clear error if the workbook has changed.

Curated so far: Chapter 2 (National Accounts) of the 2025 edition — the production accounts, GDP by activity at current and constant prices, expenditure on GDP, capital formation, national income and saving.

Usage

knbs_abstract_tables()

Value

A knbs_catalogue tibble with columns table_id, title, chapter, unit, sheet and workbook.

See also

knbs_abstract_table(), knbs_publications()

Examples

knbs_abstract_tables()
#> <knbs_catalogue>
#> Title: 2025 Statistical Abstract: curated tables
#> Rows: 15
#> Source: Kenya National Bureau of Statistics
